feature_notes: Sidebar search matches page title or any keyword case-insensitively; pressing submit jumps to the first match; if the current page filters out, the first visible page takes over
SettingsNavigation.shared.requestedPage is honoured with initial: true and cleared immediately, which is how the update notification and post-install relaunch open About
Changing the page resets scrollChrome travel to 0 and clears both the model and MCP chrome search fields

Scroll handling freezes row hit-testing while a finger is interacting (scrollTracker.note()) and unfreezes on coast/settle; wheel scrolling is caught by onScrollGeometryChange instead of phases; scrollTracker.end() on disappear
travel(_:) = geometry.contentOffset.y + geometry.contentInsets.top
ProvidersSettingsPage builds every ProviderKind section eagerly (a comment explains lazy sections were rebuilt while scrolling and re-ran their checks)
Usage (plan limits / credits) only shows when the provider exposes them AND status.isInstalled AND status.auth != .signedOut; the refresh is throttled by the registry to once a minute
Sign-in row is hidden while signed in and while a check is running, so it never flashes before the answer
API-key edits debounce 600 ms then refresh the provider and force-reload its catalog; loading the stored key into the field does not save or check it
The Hydra page is deliberately second in the sidebar, right under General; its symbol "point.3.connected.trianglepath.dotted" is never drawn because the row uses HydraMarkImage
Turning on the chime or the settle sound plays it once immediately so the user hears it
Delete flows respect settings.confirmBeforeDeleting in both the per-row Delete and Delete all
The licenses popover text is read from the bundle once into a static dictionary because the popover body re-runs on hover and scroll

Popover actions: "Clear" (destructive, only when a chord exists) and "Reset to default" (only when the shortcut is customized and has a defaultChord)
Modifier keycaps in order control (⌃ / ctrl), option (⌥ / opt), shift (⇧ / shift), command (⌘ / cmd); ghost caps are ⌘/cmd and the letter "A"
feature_notes: The page is a LazyVStack of one card per AppShortcut.Section followed by the fixed Composer card, with .focusEffectDisabled()
A chord is judged the instant its key goes down and can be replaced while anything is still held; it commits 300 ms after every key is released
Escape with no modifiers cancels the recording; app deactivation cancels it too
A rejected chord clears the latch and returns to .listening when the keys are released, so the popover keeps listening
While no modifier is held the popover shows a single ghost ⌘ cap; with modifiers but no key it shows the held modifiers plus a ghost "A" cap
ShortcutStore.refusal(for:replacing:) supplies the human-readable conflict message shown under the keycaps
Section Reset is animated with Chrome.hover and appears only when that section has customizations
Key repeat events are ignored (event.isARepeat)
The local monitor consumes matching events (returns nil) so recorded keys never reach the app

ShortcutStore's persistence format and the exact wording of refusal(for:replacing:) messages are outside this file
KeyNames.label(for:) mapping from key codes to display labels is elsewhere
Chrome.sectionSpacing / sectionHeaderSpacing / hover literal values are defined elsewhere

Mode help strings: daily "Each day on its own, against the busiest day of the year", weekly "Each week as one shade, against the busiest week", cumulative "The running total, so the year fills as it goes"
Month strip: labels at 11pt Chrome.secondaryText, positioned at column * stride clamped to [12, width - 12], y = labelHeight / 2; stride = (width + cellGap) / max(columnCount, 1)
Legend: "<formatted> tokens recorded" at 11pt secondary, then "Less", five 10x10 swatches with cornerRadius 2, then "More"; HStack spacing 8 with Spacer(minLength: 12); VStack spacing 4
Uncertain-tokens caveat (shown only when > 0): "<formatted> of these were recorded before spend kept its source, so they may overlap imported history." at 11pt secondary, fixedSize vertical
Legend accessibility: label "Token activity", value "<n> tokens recorded" or "<n> tokens recorded, <m> of them without a kept source"; the canvas itself is accessibilityHidden
Ladder sample values: [0, 1, 3, 5, 7] against maxValue 8, future false
feature_notes: Switching modes captures the current grid as previousGrid, bumps switchCount and animates with .smooth(duration: 0.45); previousGrid is cleared in the completion only if switchCount still matches that switch index

HeatmapBlendModifier animates over blend (Double(switchCount)) with base = Double(switchIndex - 1); progress = clamp(blend - base, 0, 1), and each cell is old.mix(with: new, by: progress), showing the old grid exactly at progress <= 0
Cell size = (width - gap * (columns - 1)) / columns; canvas height = cell * rows + gap * (rows - 1), so cells stay square at any width
A day is drawn as 'future' when its date >= grid.tomorrow, using the fainter Chrome.overlay(0.035)
Month labels closer together than 30pt of advance are skipped rather than overlapped
The section is deliberately plain page content, not a ChromeCard, so the grid uses the full column width
The grid is rebuilt only when the daily totals dictionary or the mode changes, to avoid redoing a year of calendar arithmetic on every usage event
Previous-grid lookup is guarded by c < previous.values.count so a shorter old grid cannot index out of range
unresolved_questions: TokenActivityGrid (rows count, column construction, maxValue and cumulative semantics) and TokenActivityMode's title strings are defined in another file
TokenLedger's storage, the dailyTotals key format (a String date key) and how uncertainTokensThisYear is computed are outside this file
UsagePanel.tokens(_:) formatting rules (K/M suffixes, grouping) are defined elsewhere
The exact appearance of .buttonStyle(.chip(active:)) is defined elsewhere

files.purpose: The Appearance card that sets the window wallpaper: a 150pt-tall preview with a glass mini-window overlay, drag-and-drop plus an NSOpenPanel chooser, Remove/Change buttons, and a Softness blur slider with a reset that only appears once the value leaves 0.
key_symbols: struct WallpaperCard: View (body, preview, wallpaperRow, softnessRow, func choose())
calls_into: WallpaperStore.shared (image: NSImage?, hasWallpaper, isInstalling, lastError, softness, isAdjustingSoftness, install(from:), remove(), static accepts(_:), static acceptedTypes)
ChromeCard, ChromeRow, ChromeRowDivider
Chrome.overlay(_:), Chrome.accent, Chrome.secondaryText
NSOpenPanel, NSApp.keyWindow
SwiftUI glassEffect(in:), dropDestination(for: URL.self, ...)
side_effects: NSOpenPanel presented as a sheet on NSApp.keyWindow (or a free-standing panel when there is no key window); on .OK it calls store.install(from: url), which copies/installs the picture
Drag-and-drop of a URL calls store.install(from:) for the first URL WallpaperStore.accepts
store.remove() clears the wallpaper; store.softness writes the blur value; store.isAdjustingSoftness is set true/false around slider editing
platform_assumptions: AppKit NSOpenPanel with allowedContentTypes / beginSheetModal(for:) / begin(_:) and NSImage; UniformTypeIdentifiers import
SwiftUI .glassEffect (Liquid Glass) for the mini-window stand-in
SF Symbols photo.on.rectangle.angled, drop, drop.fill, arrow.counterclockwise
dropDestination(for: URL.self) receiving file URLs from Finder
persisted_fields: store.softness: Double in 0...1, stock value 0 (persistence lives in WallpaperStore, not this file)
The wallpaper image itself, installed by WallpaperStore.install(from:)
ui_elements: Preview: 150pt tall, full width, clipped to RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous), image aspectRatio .fill

Mini-window overlay: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8, style: .continuous) filled .clear with glassEffect plus Color.black.opacity(0.2), three 5x5 Chrome.overlay(0.35) circles in an HStack spacing 4 padded .top 8 / .leading 8, sized 60% x 60% of the preview and centered

Empty state: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12) filled Chrome.overlay(0.04), symbol photo.on.rectangle.angled at 22pt Chrome.secondaryText, text "Drop a picture here, or choose one" at 12pt Chrome.secondaryText, VStack spacing 6
Drag highlight: Chrome.accent.opacity(0.18) fill over the 150pt rounded rect, scaleEffect 1.02, animation .snappy(duration: 0.2) on isTargeted
Image change animation .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.2); image and placeholder transition .scale(scale: 0.96) combined with .opacity; preview padded 16
Installing shows a ProgressView with controlSize .small

Wallpaper row title "Wallpaper"; detail is store.lastError when set, otherwise "Fills the window edge to edge under the glass; the transparency slider lets the desktop show through it" with a wallpaper, or "A picture of your own behind the glass, mixed with the desktop by the transparency slider" without
Buttons: "Remove" (only when a wallpaper exists) and "Choose…" / "Change…", both .buttonStyle(.glass) controlSize .small and disabled while installing; HStack spacing 8

Softness row (only when a wallpaper exists): title "Softness", detail "Blurs the picture so text stays easy to read"; icons drop (help "Sharp") and drop.fill (help "Blurred") at 11pt Chrome.secondaryText; Slider 0...1 controlSize .small width 140

Softness reset: arrow.counterclockwise at 11pt medium in a 22x22 frame, offset x: -28, help "Back to sharp", transition .opacity combined with .offset(x: 6), animation .snappy(duration: 0.2) on isOffStock; accessibility label "Wallpaper softness"
Open panel: message "Choose a picture for the window", prompt "Use as Wallpaper", allowsMultipleSelection false, canChooseDirectories false
feature_notes: Clicking anywhere on the preview opens the file chooser (the preview is itself a plain-styled Button)
Only the first dropped URL that passes WallpaperStore.accepts is installed; the drop returns false if none match
The Softness row and its divider are hidden entirely until a wallpaper exists
The reset control is shown only when softness > 0.005 and takes no layout room, so the slider stays flush with other card controls
store.isAdjustingSoftness is toggled with the slider's onEditingChanged, so other code can react to a live drag
The chooser is run as a window sheet when there is a key window so the settings sheet is not blocked
unresolved_questions: WallpaperStore's accepted UTTypes, where the installed image is written, and how softness is persisted are defined in another file
The exact error strings that can appear in store.lastError are not visible here
Whether store.softness maps linearly to a blur radius, and what radius, is decided in WallpaperStore / the backdrop view
